p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (EU import or export business)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: Sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer manages everything from seller's factory
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller ships the goods that have passed export clearance to the buyer's shipping company.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller ships the goods to ship. After that, risk and expense are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: Seller pays freight and insurance to the port of arrival
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers goods to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: Seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere weapons, drugs, counterfeit products, protected wildlife (CITES), certain drugs, these lists will be rejected and can be reported.

p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a distributor (list "retailer/distributor" here or retail platform) and order samples before you sell.

p.espaces.ds_s6: Respect for consumer rights, clear pricing including taxes, right to return, warranty, privacy.
